dataset.citation: Casanueva et al. (2020), Efficient Intent Detection with Dual Sentence Encoders.
dataset.split_justification: The cached split is 'train'. It is used as an evaluation pool because the intent classifier under test is ZERO-SHOT: no Banking77 data is used for training, fine-tuning or few-shot prompting anywhere in this project, so train-split utterances are unseen text to it. Stated explicitly rather than reported as 'Banking77' without qualification.

methodology: Banking77 is a retail-banking CUSTOMER-SERVICE dataset: card issues,
transfers, top-ups, fees, identity verification. This system's 8 buckets
are a FINANCIAL-ADVISORY taxonomy that happens to also cover general
banking support. The two only partially overlap by design, not by
oversight — investment_advice, risk_profiling, budget_analysis, and
full_advisory describe advisory conversations Banking77 was never built
to contain (it has no 'help me plan my finances' or 'what's my risk
tolerance' queries at all). Mapping every one of the 77 labels into
one of these 8 buckets, honestly, means several buckets get zero
labels — that's the correct outcome of an honest mapping, not a bug
in it. See bucket_coverage_summary and domain_gap_note below.
Three-way discriminator used for every label:
general_query      — status check, dispute, fee query, informational,
troubleshooting: the user has a PROBLEM or a
QUESTION about something that already exists.
product_suggestion — the user wants to OBTAIN, CHOOSE, or CONFIGURE a
product (get a card, link a card, pick a card
type) — about ACQUIRING, not fixing or asking.
explanation_request — the user is asking WHY the system requires or
does something (matches the bucket's own
definition — 'why', 'explain', 'reasoning').
The remaining 5 buckets (risk_profiling, investment_advice,
budget_analysis, full_advisory, out_of_scope) describe conversations
outside Banking77's domain entirely — see domain_gap_note.
domain_gap_note: 5 of 8 buckets get zero Banking77 labels: risk_profiling, investment_advice,
budget_analysis, full_advisory, out_of_scope. This is expected, not an error
in the mapping — Banking77 has no financial-advisory or out-of-domain
(legal/medical) content at all; it is entirely retail-banking support
queries, which is entirely 'in scope' for a banking assistant by
construction. This means the evaluation CANNOT test precision/recall for
those 5 buckets directly (there are no true positives available for them
in this dataset) — but it CAN and should test something arguably more
important: whether the classifier spuriously predicts one of those 5
buckets for an ordinary banking-service query. Over-triggering into
full_advisory or investment_advice for a plain card-payment question would
be exactly the 'magnet' failure mode already flagged in
agents/conversational_agent.py's own comments on the full_advisory bucket
— false-positive leakage INTO these buckets is the measurable signal here,
bucket_map.labels_unchanged: The bucket map is used exactly as committed. No label was edited, added or removed for this evaluation.

sampling.method: proportional stratified by banking77 fine label (77 strata)
sampling.reproducible: Deterministic given (items, n, seed). Re-running produces the identical sample on any machine.

prompt_leakage_check.conclusion: Zero-shot use of the train split is sound: no sampled utterance appears in the classifier's prompt.

dataset.labels_note: Bucket labels come from data/banking77_bucket_map.json exactly as committed. No label was changed for this evaluation, and no item was excluded on the basis of whether the model got it right.

class_imbalance_warning.interpretation: 84% of this sample's ground truth is a single bucket (general_query), and 5 bucket(s) have zero support (risk_profiling, investment_advice, budget_analysis, full_advisory, out_of_scope). A classifier that always predicted 'general_query' would score close to this run's 0.862 accuracy without discriminating anything. macro_f1 (0.175) is not inflated the same way — report it alongside, or instead of, raw accuracy here. See buckets_without_ground_truth for which buckets this dataset cannot evaluate at all.

false_positive_leakage_into_advisory_buc.why_this_is_the_relevant_number: Banking77 provides no positive examples for the five advisory buckets, so their precision/recall are undefined. What IS measurable is how often a customer-service utterance is misrouted into one of them — each such case sends a banking query to a specialist advisory agent in production.
